title: LearnOps model and speech interface (B5, v1)
description: The data that crosses the shared model and speech interface (PRD B5): the meta record of a language-model call (result.meta, B5.1) and a transcript returned by the speech interface (B5.4). A document is one of the two. result.data is not described here: its shape is the output_schema of the task that was called (B5.1).
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced here: result.data matches the task's output_schema (B5.1); invalid structured output gets one retry and then a clear error, never a partial result (B5.2); provider and model are chosen by MODEL_PROVIDER and MODEL_NAME and keys come from environment variables only (B5.2); prompts are versioned files in libs/model_interface/prompts/ (B5.3); every call's meta is logged to shared.model_calls with no raw learner content (B5.3); a segment or word ends at or after its start, and segments are in time order (B5.4).

provider.description: local: the lab endpoint; hosted: one hosted API through the provider's official SDK (PRD B5.2, B5.4).

model_name.description: The model that answered, as configured by MODEL_NAME (PRD B5.2).

cost.description: Estimated cost of the call. The local provider reports 0.

model_result_meta.description: result.meta of one model.run call (PRD B5.1); the record logged to shared.model_calls (B5.3).

prompt_version.description: Version of the prompt file used (PRD B5.3).

transcript.description: Return value of speech.transcribe(audio_path, language) (PRD B5.4).
